notes: Sahil Bloom is one of most dynamic up and coming creators in the financial community. He spent a decade in investment banking and private equity before turning to writing prolific threads about finance and frameworks to have a more fulfilling life and career. He's amassed over a half a million followers on Twitter in just the last two years, writes a blog called The Curiosity Chronicle, started a podcast, and recently launched a seed stage venture fund called SRB Ventures. Our conversation covers Sahil's upbringing, his career in private equity, developing his own edge, and transitioning from the corporate world to life as a creator. We then discuss his favorite frameworks and how they apply to investing, including mentorship, goal setting, luck, and paradoxes of life. We close with the details of his recent fund launch, audience engagement, and how he manages his time.  Sahil Bloom – Creativity, Investing, and Engineered Serendipity (Capital Allocators, EP.249) May 9, 2022

 Sahil Bloom is one of most dynamic up and coming creators in
the financial community. He spent a decade in investment banking
and private equity before turning to writing prolific threads about
finance and frameworks to have a more fulfilling life and career.
He’s amassed over a half a million followers on Twitter in just the
last two years, writes a blog called The Curiosity Chronicle,
started a podcast, and recently launched a seed stage venture fund
called SRB Ventures. 
 

Our conversation covers Sahil’s upbringing, his career in private
equity, developing his own edge, and transitioning from the
corporate world to life as a creator. We then discuss his favorite
frameworks and how they apply to investing, including mentorship,
goal setting, luck, and paradoxes of life. We close with the
details of his recent fund launch, audience engagement, and how he
manages his time.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
